name: A Rogue's Deal
summary: In Deathknell, Calvin Montague asks you to carry an unmarked message to Brill. He calls it a simple delivery and promises generous coin.

sections.title: A Friendly Courier
sections.body: Calvin Montague lounges among Deathknell's graves and ruined chapels. He says Scourge zombies and creeping spiders have worn him down, then asks you to carry an unmarked letter to Brill. He promises generous coin. For a newly awakened Forsaken, it seems a simple way to reach the region's main town.

sections.title: The Gallows' End Tavern
sections.body:
The road east crosses Tirisfal Glades and passes Cold Hearth Manor before reaching Brill. At the Gallows' End Tavern, Innkeeper Renee greets newcomers warmly and fusses over their comfort. But when she receives Montague's letter, her manner breaks. She pretends it brings news from a beloved mother, then scolds you for prying and demands you buy something or leave.

When you return to Calvin, he challenges you to a duel instead of peacefully paying what he promised.

faq.answer: Calvin Montague is a rogue in Deathknell who asks newly awakened travelers to carry a letter to Innkeeper Renee in Brill. He calls it a simple favor and promises generous pay.

faq.q: What is inside the Nondescript Letter?
faq.answer: The letter's exact contents are not recorded. Calvin gives you an unmarked message for Innkeeper Renee in Brill.

faq.q: Why does Innkeeper Renee act so strange?
faq.answer: Innkeeper Renee runs the tavern in Brill and insists that her correspondence is private. You see her response when you bring her Montague's letter.

faq.q: Does Calvin Montague actually pay for the delivery?
faq.answer: Calvin Montague promises generous pay for the delivery. Renee offers food or water when the letter reaches her. Return to Calvin afterward to continue dealing with him over the promised payment.
Brill lies northeast of Deathknell. Follow the main road east out of the starter valley, veer right past Cold Hearth Manor, and cross a covered bridge into town.

faq.q: What happens after giving the letter to Renee?
faq.answer: After giving Renee the letter, return to Calvin Montague in Deathknell to continue dealing with him.

angles.text: As a newly risen Forsaken, you make your first journey away from Deathknell's graveyard and head for Brill, the region's busy hub.
As a rogue, you glimpse the informal dealings around Deathknell and Brill through Calvin Montague's private courier errand.
As a member of the Horde, you travel to Brill, a regional center of Forsaken administration and a place of respite in Tirisfal.
